name: Remove Background Mask
description: Finds the subject of a picture and gives it as a mask (white is the subject, soft at its edge). Wire the mask to Inpaint, Crop to Mask or Composite Masked, or use the group Remove Background for a cutout with a transparent background. Invert gives the background instead. BiRefNet through ONNX Runtime.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A BiRefNet ONNX file. The picker offers the downloads, with their licence shown first.

inputs.name: invert
inputs.label: Invert
inputs.description: Give the background as the mask instead of the subject.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: 0 keeps the soft edge. Above 0, everything at least this sure to be the subject becomes 1 and the rest 0.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Auto uses the GPU when the pack's environment has the CUDA build of ONNX Runtime.
